metadataReview.note: Correct the date to 27 November 1879, printed on the contemporary battle sketch preserved by the Biblioteca Nacional de Chile. The map depicts the initial attack in the ravine and adjoining heights. It is a schematic plan with an approximate distance scale, without a latitude/longitude grid or reviewed modern control points. The event therefore remains unlocated; neither the modern town centre nor an unverified memorial is adopted as its battle position.

note:
The contemporary Biblioteca Nacional de Chile battle sketch explicitly distinguishes Chilean and Peruvian formations in its legend. These are two sourced, unquantified event-local forces. Its initial-attack symbols are not counted as soldiers, units or a complete order of battle. No all-campaign total, additional coalition contingent, strength, death or casualty estimate is inferred. No equipment identity or profile is assigned. Coordinates remain unknown pending reliable georeferencing.

Correct the date to 27 November 1879, printed on the contemporary battle sketch preserved by the Biblioteca Nacional de Chile. The map depicts the initial attack in the ravine and adjoining heights. It is a schematic plan with an approximate distance scale, without a latitude/longitude grid or reviewed modern control points. The event therefore remains unlocated; neither the modern town centre nor an unverified memorial is adopted as its battle position.
